text_en: Then I looked, and above the dome that was over the heads of the cherubim there appeared above them something like a sapphire, in form resembling a throne.
text_cn: 我观望时，见在革鲁宾头上，穹苍之上，有一块像碧玉的石头，看似宝座，出现在他们上边。

text_en: He said to the man clothed in linen, “Go within the wheelwork underneath the cherubim; fill your hands with burning coals from among the cherubim, and scatter them over the city. ” He went in as I looked on.
text_cn: 上主问那身穿细麻衣的人说：“你到革鲁宾下边的轮子中间，由革鲁宾中间取一满掬火炭，撒在城上。”他就在我眼前进去了。

text_en: Now the cherubim were standing on the south side of the house when the man went in; and a cloud filled the inner court.
text_cn: 当那人进去时，革鲁宾站在圣殿的右边，云彩弥漫了内院。

text_en: Then the glory of the Lord rose up from the cherub to the threshold of the house; the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the glory of the Lord .
text_cn: 上主的光荣，由革鲁宾之间升起，停在圣殿的门限上，圣殿内充满了云彩，庭院中也充满了上主光荣的灿烂。

text_en: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.
text_cn: 革鲁宾展翅的响声达于外院，像全能的天主讲话的声音。

text_en: When he commanded the man clothed in linen, “Take fire from within the wheelwork, from among the cherubim, ” he went in and stood beside a wheel.
text_cn: 以后他吩咐那身穿细麻衣的人说：“从轮子中间，从革鲁宾中间取火吧！”那人就前去，站在轮子旁边。

text_en: And a cherub stretched out his hand from among the cherubim to the fire that was among the cherubim, took some of it and put it into the hands of the man clothed in linen, who took it and went out.
text_cn: 一位革鲁宾由革鲁宾中间伸手，到革鲁宾中间的火上取了火，放在那身穿细麻衣的手中；那人接过去就走了。

text_en: The cherubim appeared to have the form of a human hand under their wings.
text_cn: 我看见革鲁宾在翅膀下的手好像人手。

text_en: I looked, and there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one beside each cherub; and the appearance of the wheels was like gleaming beryl.
text_cn: 我观望时，见革鲁宾旁边有四个轮子，每一位革鲁宾旁有一个轮子，轮子的外表光泽有如橄榄玉石。

text_en: And as for their appearance, the four looked alike, something like a wheel within a wheel.
text_cn: 轮子的外表，四个都有同样的形状，好像轮子套在轮子中。

text_en: When they moved, they moved in any of the four directions without veering as they moved; but in whatever direction the front wheel faced, the others followed without veering as they moved.
text_cn: 转动时可向四面旋转，前行时不必回转；头朝着哪一方，它们都向那一方转动，前行时不必回转。

text_en: Their entire body, their rims, their spokes, their wings, and the wheels—the wheels of the four of them—were full of eyes all around.
text_cn: 在他们的身体、背、手、翅膀和四个轮子上，布满了眼睛。

text_en: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing “the wheelwork. ”
text_cn: 我所说的轮子名叫“加耳加耳。”

text_en: Each one had four faces: the first face was that of the cherub, the second face was that of a human being, the third that of a lion, and the fourth that of an eagle.
text_cn: 每一个革鲁宾有四个形状：第一个形状是牛形，第二个形状是人形，第三个形状是狮形，第四个形状是鹰形。

text_en: The cherubim rose up. These were the living creatures that I saw by the river Chebar.
text_cn: 以后革鲁宾上升去了；这是我在革巴尔河岸所见的活物。

text_en: When the cherubim moved, the wheels moved beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to rise up from the earth, the wheels at their side did not veer.
text_cn: 革鲁宾前行时，轮子也在他们旁边转动；革鲁宾展开翅膀，由地面升起时，轮子也不离他们左右。

text_en: When they stopped, the others stopped, and when they rose up, the others rose up with them; for the spirit of the living creatures was in them.
text_cn: 他们站住，轮子也停下；他们升起，轮子也同他们一起升起，因为轮子内有活物的神力。

text_en: Then the glory of the Lord went out from the threshold of the house and stopped above the cherubim.
text_cn: 那时，上主的光荣离开了圣殿的门限，停在革鲁宾上。

text_en: The cherubim lifted up their wings and rose up from the earth in my sight as they went out with the wheels beside them. They stopped at the entrance of the east gate of the house of the Lord ; and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
text_cn: 革鲁宾展开翅膀，在我眼前由地面升起；当他们离去时，轮子也跟着离去。他们停在上主圣殿的东门门口时，以色列的天主的光荣就停在他们上面。

text_en: These were the living creatures that I saw underneath the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
text_cn: 这就是我靠近革巴尔河，在以色列的天主下面所见的那些活物，现在我明白他们是革鲁宾。

text_en: Each had four faces, each four wings, and underneath their wings something like human hands.
text_cn: 每个有四样形状，每个有四个翅膀，在他们翅膀下有相似人的手。

text_en: As for what their faces were like, they were the same faces whose appearance I had seen by the river Chebar. Each one moved straight ahead.
text_cn: 关于他们的形像，和我靠近革巴尔河所见的形像一样，每个朝自己的前面进行。
